units.rawText: The Oasis is more peaceful than I expected, or at least it seems that way. Still, did the Oasis not even have something as basic as a zoo before I came?

units.rawText: Or rather, it's because I'm here that the workers at the Oasis now have another option for relaxation, right... Make sure you come to the zoo to visit.

units.rawText: Huh? People think my zoo is weird? Even you're saying that, Caretaker?

units.rawText: ...Well, a lot of people have been saying that too... Could that be the reason why we haven't been getting any visitors…
